scope: Selected primary sources and official software documentation for a proposed copper-sphere position spectroscopy experiment. This is not an exhaustive SOTA survey or validation of every cited result.
venue_policy: Actual venue and publication status are stated. ICLR 2025 and NeurIPS 2024 accepted main-conference papers are included for inverse-model methodology; direct experimental evidence primarily comes from specialist physics and metrology journals. No universal Tier A label is assigned.
ai_release_note: The OpenAI October 6 mathematics release is identified and its relevant family 372 scoped. No equivalent single Anthropic bulk mathematics release was established in this targeted search; specific official September/October reports are included.

sources.title: On the Vibrations of an Elastic Sphere
sources.venue: Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society, s1-13, 189–212
sources.claim: Classical elastic-sphere normal-mode formulation.
sources.relevance: Foundation for distinguishing radial, spheroidal and torsional modes.
sources.limits: Publisher dates this article 1881; many later references cite 1882. Metadata checked; original derivation not independently reconstructed from this scan.
sources.access_read_depth: Publisher bibliographic record

sources.title: Resonant Ultrasound Spectroscopy: theory and application
sources.claim: RUS infers elastic parameters by matching normal modes; measured response also depends on excitation and readout sites.
sources.relevance: Separates eigenfrequencies from transfer-function amplitudes and gives a forward/inverse workflow.
sources.limits: Its case study is rock and cylinder spectroscopy. Coupling, mode assignment and model adequacy remain necessary for the copper sphere.
sources.access_read_depth: Full text sections 1–3.3, including generalized eigenproblem and excitation discussion

sources.title: Vibration analysis of an elastic-sphere oscillator contacting semi-infinite viscoelastic solids in resonant ultrasound microscopy
sources.claim: Dynamic sphere-contact modeling predicts resonance shifts; the reported experiment better matched the dynamic model than a quasistatic approximation.
sources.relevance: Direct control for an apparent location effect caused by a different support contact.
sources.limits: Steel sphere and specified contacting media; reported shifts cannot be copied numerically to copper on an arbitrary table.
sources.access_read_depth: Institutional full PDF: introduction, model scope, results and experimental comparison

sources.title: On the establishment of a method for characterization of material microstructure through laser-based resonant ultrasound spectroscopy
sources.venue: IEEE Transactions on Ultrasonics, Ferroelectrics, and Frequency Control 55(4), 770–776
sources.claim: Laser RUS measured 40 of the first 50 resonant modes in high-purity polycrystalline copper.
sources.relevance: Direct material precedent for optical detection and mode-shape matching.
sources.limits: High chemical purity does not remove microstructure or elastic anisotropy. The paper does not establish a unique location frequency.
sources.access_read_depth: Idaho National Laboratory abstract and bibliographic record; full paper not read

sources.title: Elastic characterization of ceramic balls using resonant ultrasound spectroscopy of spheroidal modes
sources.claim: A ball-spectroscopy setup combines ultrasonic excitation and optical interferometric detection of spheroidal modes.
sources.relevance: Concrete geometry and readout precedent for ball experiments.
sources.limits: Ceramic specimens, not copper; radial optical sensitivity does not guarantee detection of every torsional mode.
sources.access_read_depth: Six-page conference PDF: abstract, sphere mode model and experimental method

sources.title: Evaluation of 3D optical techniques for modal analysis during climatic test inside environmental chamber
sources.claim: SLDV and DIC measured temperature-dependent modal parameters; optical paths through a chamber introduced measurement limitations.
sources.relevance: Supports temperature logging, matched optical geometry and environment controls.
sources.limits: The specimen is curved polymer; its temperature coefficients are not copper coefficients.
sources.access_read_depth: Institutional PDF: experimental details, temperature validation, results and conclusions

sources.title: Multi-beam full-field laser Doppler vibrometer based on a high-speed area scan CMOS camera
sources.claim: A simultaneous 17 × 17-point LDV demonstrates full-field phase-preserving vibration measurements over a finite band up to 25 kHz.
sources.relevance: Explains why multipoint sensing helps distinguish mode shape from a single-point spectral peak.
sources.limits: The reported bandwidth may miss higher copper-sphere modes. Abstract and instrument performance summary only; underlying data are request-only.
sources.access_read_depth: Publisher abstract, publication history and data-availability statement

sources.title: Full-field laser-Doppler-vibrometry FRF dataset for a four-bolt aluminum plate under bolt-torque variation
sources.claim: Authors report spatial amplitude/phase FRFs for multiple bolt-torque states.
sources.relevance: A recent example of how support state changes a spatial vibration dataset.
sources.limits: Aluminum plate, not copper sphere. Abstract indexed by search; direct page and full text fetch failed. Dataset and claimed performance were not replayed.
sources.access_read_depth: Search-indexed primary abstract only; direct access failed

sources.title: scipy.signal.csd
sources.claim: Welch cross-spectral density uses conjugate(X) × Y by convention.
sources.relevance: With input force x and response y, H1 = Pxy/Pxx has the correct complex phase convention.
sources.limits: Correct units, sample timing, windowing and calibration remain caller responsibilities.
sources.access_read_depth: Official API parameters, units, convention and notes

sources.title: scipy.signal.coherence
sources.claim: Magnitude-squared coherence is |Pxy|²/(Pxx Pyy).
sources.relevance: Quality control for paired input/response measurements.
sources.limits: High coherence alone does not establish causation or eliminate shared disturbances.
sources.access_read_depth: Official API formula and Welch settings

sources.title: pyFRF
sources.claim: Open-source structural-dynamics FRF estimation includes H1, H2 and Hv estimators.
sources.relevance: Candidate offline implementation for measured force/response runs.
sources.limits: Not installed or benchmarked in this source review; pin a version before production use.
sources.access_read_depth: Repository README, API example and MIT license label

sources.title: pyOMA2: A Python module for conducting operational modal analysis
sources.claim: Open-source operational modal-analysis package.
sources.relevance: Candidate ambient table modal-identification workflow after calibrated recording.
sources.limits: Operational analysis assumptions must be checked; it cannot identify an entire intrinsic spectrum from arbitrary ambient noise.
sources.access_read_depth: JOSS publication record and official repository README/license label

sources.title: SfePy: Simple Finite Elements in Python
sources.claim: Finite-element framework for coupled PDE models.
sources.relevance: Future anisotropic sphere, cradle and table-coupling model after measured geometry is available.
sources.limits: No complete FEM mesh or converged copper experiment was executed by this source review.
sources.access_read_depth: Official introduction and BSD three-clause license text

sources.title: Physics-Informed Deep Inverse Operator Networks for Solving PDE Inverse Problems
sources.claim: PI-DION combines measurement and PDE-residual losses with problem-specific stability estimates.
sources.relevance: Useful future inverse-model methodology after declaring the measurement operator and identifiability assumptions.
sources.limits: Its stated PDE examples and regularity hypotheses do not prove recovery of copper properties or position from two spectra. No neural operator is trained here.
sources.access_read_depth: Official proceedings PDF sections 1–3, including stability assumptions

sources.title: Latent Neural Operator for Solving Forward and Inverse PDE Problems
sources.claim: LNO learns forward/inverse PDE maps in a latent representation and evaluates at requested spatial points.
sources.relevance: Potential surrogate for a validated multi-position simulation campaign.
sources.limits: Benchmark accuracy and speed are not transferable guarantees; a surrogate needs held-out support, temperature and geometry tests.
sources.access_read_depth: Official proceedings abstract and accepted venue metadata

sources.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics / openai/math release
sources.venue: Official research announcement and manuscript repository
sources.claim: A public mathematics manuscript collection includes proof artifacts at differing verification stages.
sources.relevance: Identifies the requested recent OpenAI paper release and encourages explicit dependency and verification records.
sources.limits: This is not an experimental copper dataset; the collection was not comprehensively audited. Current README count is 719 manuscripts in 372 families, not a timeless count.
sources.access_read_depth: Official announcement, README, catalogue keyword search and family 372 scope note

sources.title: Global Uniqueness for the Smooth Isotropic Elasticity Inverse Problem
sources.claim: The release claims uniqueness of smooth isotropic Lamé moduli from a full static boundary displacement-to-traction map.
sources.relevance: Highlights how demanding complete inverse recovery is compared with finite-band measurements at two positions.
sources.limits: Not independently proved or Lean-checked here. The stated result gives uniqueness, not a reconstruction algorithm, and requires full boundary data. It is not used as a calculator premise.
sources.access_read_depth: Catalogue abstract and author formalization-scope note; paper proof not audited

sources.title: Formalizing Fermat’s Last Theorem
sources.claim: Anthropic reports a Lean formalization organized with a dependency graph and independent statement checks.
sources.relevance: Methodology inspiration: retain explicit claims, dependencies and executable checks.
sources.limits: Number-theory formalization is not evidence for position-dependent copper resonances. This project has not replayed that Lean development.
sources.access_read_depth: Official report methodology and verification sections; linked repository existence

sources.title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
sources.claim: The reported workflow combines circuit specifications with automated correctness and resource evaluators.
sources.relevance: Methodology inspiration for code proposals judged by an independently specified physical model and tests.
sources.limits: Quantum-circuit optimization is not a measurement of a copper ball and supplies no resonant frequency or location law.
sources.access_read_depth: Primary abstract, submission metadata and official report workflow

sources.title: Longitudinal versus transverse spheroidal vibrational modes of an elastic sphere
sources.authors: Lucien Saviot and Daniel B. Murray
sources.claim: A homogeneous isotropic traction-free sphere has distinct torsional and spheroidal families. Radial l=0 modes use the T11 boundary condition, with size and sound-speed dependence.
sources.relevance: Material, boundary and measurement assumptions in the local calculator.
sources.limits: The HTML conversion displays an August2026 date; original version/publication metadata establish2005. Selected l=0 implementation is not full-mode completeness.
sources.access_read_depth: Full SectionII free-sphere formulation, equations1–3 and l=0 reduction; SectionIII opening and derivative interpretation; abstract and original metadata.

sources.title: Vibrational eigenmodes of an isotropic sphere
sources.claim: Useful external mode-family tool and reference; inputs are longitudinal/transverse speeds, diameter, family and indices.
sources.relevance: Material, boundary and measurement assumptions in the local calculator.
sources.limits: The page specifically warns about an incorrect spheroidal l=0 frequency expression in a cited textbook. Its disclaimer is use at own risk.
sources.access_read_depth: Full explanatory page and reference list; interactive outputs were not used as the independent numerical implementation.

sources.title: Elastic Properties of Metals and Alloys. II. Copper
sources.venue: Journal of Physical and Chemical Reference Data3,897
sources.claim: Compiled copper elastic properties distinguish polycrystal effective values, single-crystal constants, temperature and processing effects. Table10 averages E123.5GPa and nu0.350 inform illustrative defaults.
sources.relevance: Material, boundary and measurement assumptions in the local calculator.
sources.limits: Literature averages and their standard errors are not a certificate of the proposed ball. Independently averaged constants may not obey one exact isotropic identity. Density8960kg/m3 is a rounded illustrative input.
sources.access_read_depth: Introduction, Sections9–10, Table10 (PDFpage28/printed923), Table12 (PDFpage30/printed925), selected density entries in Table9.

sources.title: Resonant ultrasound spectroscopy and homogeneity in polycrystals
sources.authors: Gunes Kaplan, T.W. Darling and K.R. McCall
sources.claim: Pure copper's grain-size distribution can violate the homogeneous effective model assumed when interpreting RUS.
sources.relevance: Material, boundary and measurement assumptions in the local calculator.
sources.limits: The source's particular observed grain-size criterion is sample/study-specific and is not adopted as a universal acceptance threshold here. Online publication2008, journal issue2009.
sources.access_read_depth: Primary abstract via PubMed and publication metadata; full paper not read.

sources.title: Resonance ultrasonic spectroscopy applied to normal and tangential contact modes investigation of a constrained metallic sphere
sources.authors: M. de Billy and F. Cohen Tenoudji
sources.claim: A compressed steel sphere has contact-conditioned low-frequency motion in addition to internal deformation modes; applied force changes contact spectral peaks.
sources.relevance: Material, boundary and measurement assumptions in the local calculator.
sources.limits: Material and loading differ from the proposed copper experiment. The browser's spring example is pedagogical, not a reproduced fit to this experiment.
sources.access_read_depth: Primary abstract, highlights and bibliographic records; full paper not read.

sources.title: Resonant Ultrasound Spectroscopy for Irregularly Shaped Samples and Its Application to Uranium Ditelluride
sources.claim: Finite mounting force and orientation contribute to the uncertainty; remounting is an experimental control.
sources.relevance: Independent review of experimental controls and uncertainty.
sources.limits: Published 2024 source. HTML also displays a later generated date; canonical version is arXiv v2 dated 12 March 2024. Numerical values are not applied to copper.
sources.access_read_depth: Methods, measurement uncertainty, and Supplement VII.5

sources.title: The effect of gas loading on the RUS spectra of spheres
sources.authors: R. S. Sorbello, J. Feller, M. Levy, D. G. Isaak, J. D. Carnes, O. L. Anderson
sources.venue: Journal of the Acoustical Society of America 107, 808–818
sources.claim: Sphere resonance frequencies and Q respond to gas-loading conditions; model agreement is mode-dependent.
sources.relevance: Independent review of experimental controls and uncertainty.
sources.limits: Fused silica at elevated gas pressures, not copper at ambient pressure.

sources.authors: Joint Committee for Guides in Metrology
sources.claim: Use sensitivities and covariances in the combined uncertainty; correlated inputs cannot always be combined as independent terms.
sources.relevance: Independent review of experimental controls and uncertainty.
sources.limits: Linearized uncertainty propagation requires checking its approximation and coverage assumptions.

sources.title: Fieldwork position spectroscopy: executable model and independent controls
sources.claim: Independent radial-stress checks, scaling and sampling controls, fixed-pole peak-switching examples, and synthetic data-analysis tests passed.
sources.relevance: Reproducible local implementation of established methods.
sources.limits: No hardware measurements, external peer review, full-mode completeness or novelty proof.

topics.label: Object modes
topics.description: A linear elastic model has mode families determined by material, shape and boundary conditions.

topics.label: Support and contact
topics.description: Contact stiffness and damping can shift resonances and alter visibility.

topics.label: Spatial transfer functions
topics.description: At a table point, response depends on forcing, mode shapes, propagation and readout.

topics.label: Temperature drift
topics.description: Material parameters and geometry can vary with temperature; fit or control this effect.

topics.label: Finite measurement band
topics.description: Sensors and acquisition observe a declared band and channel, not every possible frequency.

topics.label: Match the same mode
topics.description: Compare mode shape and complex response, not only the largest peak.

topics.label: Inverse uniqueness limits
topics.description: Full object-property recovery from the proposed finite observations is not established.

topics.label: Executable verification
topics.description: Local numerical calculations and synthetic controls were independently checked; apparatus performance remains unmeasured.

topics.label: Future inverse surrogate
topics.description: Train only after validated forward models and measured data support the intended inverse problem.

topics.label: Residual position effect
topics.description: A residual A/B change after controlled support, sensor, temperature and time effects requires real measurements.
